headline: Pangenome graphs resolve structural and TE variation linked to traits and environment
label: Pangenome Structural Variation Genomics
summary: Graph pangenomes now reach beyond single references to link structural variants with traits, climate adaptation, and organellar-origin insertions.
synthesis: The dominant thread is genome-resolution characterization of structural and transposable element variation using graph pangenomes built beyond a single reference. The eggplant sub-pangenome integrates 11 long-read assemblies with six published genomes across 226 accessions and associates a 12.4 Mb chromosome 10 inversion with fruit color and bacterial wilt resistance. The wild Amur grape study constructs a graph pangenome and variant map, linking transposable element-associated variants to climatic adaptation and lower projected climate genetic offset. What is new in these plant studies is the pairing of pangenome structure with trait- and environment-level association. PG-NUMT extends graph-based pangenome methods to nuclear-embedded mitochondrial DNA, boosting NUMT detection sensitivity 2.52-fold and building a NUMT map across primates. The wheat preprint uses k-mer analysis of a wild emmer panel and a chromosome-scale dikaryon assembly to trace origins of non-brittle rachis Ttbtr1 alleles, a distinct question that shares the accession-level diversity focus.
